checks.name: A forged proof record for another Checkout or destination never certifies a reviewed event
The exact deadline rejects even valid acknowledgement and closes input/timer once
Sixteen invalid lines stop before a later valid line and retain no private input
Oversized acknowledgement and extra fields are refused before the one valid exact record
Lost input result cannot become reviewed acceptance; bounded finalizer still removes same endpoint
Financial cleanup failure skips the checkpoint and cannot close the financial phase
An unverified account cannot disable/delete an endpoint or open a checkpoint
Both exact archives must be confirmed before waiting; one archive failure still triggers deletion
Retained cleanup may finish after expiry during review without another create or budget identity
A lost durable pre-DELETE journal write prevents physical DELETE and cannot be blindly replayed
Remaining physical allowance cannot be reset by acknowledgement or cleanup retries
The endpoint is read again after review; a phase, mode or version change prevents deletion
